amendments.change: Add explicit per-batch build and corpus/probe audit commands; provide the batch audit helper during P2-04.
amendments.reason: A task deliverable/document check alone is insufficient to verify a parser integration. This refines acceptance without starting adapters before the harness.
json-iterator/go v1.1.12 native Unmarshal treats trailing NUL as end of input; reproduced acceptance of null\0false, 0\0, and object\0garbage in every pinned Config preset.
amendments.change: Use the same native configuration NewDecoder.Decode and inspect Buffered plus unread bytes for one-text framing; only RFC whitespace may follow. Retain native value decoding and document the adaptation. No fixture expectation changes.

amendments.reason: The initial json-iterator Decoder.Buffered framing approach returned stale numeric bytes at EOF and incorrectly rejected scalar 0; focused smoke tests caught it. Preliminary audit was interrupted and is not result evidence.
amendments.change: Use the same native configuration BorrowIterator/ReadVal and WhatIsNext, accepting only a genuine io.EOF. This preserves scalar and number policies while distinguishing NUL from EOF.

amendments.reason: Sonic ConfigDefault serialized stored invalid UTF-8 byte 0xff as raw 22ff22; the JSON envelope otherwise replaced that byte, concealing serializer behavior.
amendments.change: Extend observations with serialized_invalid_utf8 and serialized_bytes_hex, validate/retain them, and rerun the batch after regression coverage. Previous pre-extension audit remains diagnostic only.

amendments.reason: Source review disproved the implicit generic-adapter assumption: gojay DecodeInterface delegates to stdlib; new jsonparser modes and json-smart tag/POM and trailing-data flags need explicit handling.
amendments.change: Split P3-02 into a verified source/API review followed immediately by P3-02-ADAPTERS integration. Preserve priority and all three candidates; source review is not coverage. Native gojay integration must avoid generic stdlib delegation.

amendments.reason: Native smoke checks found jsonparser numeric getter tokens include trailing garbage and json-smart internal 0x1a EOI ignores remaining bytes even in strictest mode. gojay has no public consumed-offset getter.
amendments.change: Use native jsonparser ParseFloat validation with explicit mode labels/range limits; disable json-smart trailing-data flag and check pinned native byte position; use gojay native typed callbacks plus pinned read-only cursor reflection. Preserve raw inputs and native extension values; reflection failures surface as adapter crashes.
